versions.subject: Merge PR #4380 from @SethHanford - Lnx container discovery
versions.detection:
selection_tools:
    Image|endswith:
        - 'awk'
        - '/cat'
        - 'grep'
        - '/head'
        - '/less'
        - '/more'
        - '/nl'
        - '/tail'
selection_procfs_kthreadd:  # ouside containers, PID 2 == kthreadd
    CommandLine|contains: '/proc/2/'
selection_procfs_target:
    CommandLine|contains: '/proc/'
    CommandLine|endswith:
        - '/cgroup'  # cgroups end in ':/' outside containers
        - '/sched'   # PID mismatch when run in containers
condition: selection_tools and 1 of selection_procfs_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*awk", "*/cat", "*grep", "*/head", "*/less", "*/more", "*/nl", "*/tail") CommandLine="*/proc/2/*" OR (CommandLine="*/proc/*" CommandLine IN ("*/cgroup", "*/sched"))
